Element 84 Segment Length (N3) excludes the Data Type Indicator and equals 26 bytes per RID group, the same hybrid framing convention as Segment DL7

Inclusion of Segment DL8 in a table load depends on a terminal-level Special flag maintained at the BUYPASS Host; not observable from a single segment observation, and its position in the Table Load Response is not given in 11.7.1.2 or the Chapter 12 matrix
